title: Software Engineer
description: Develop scalable web applications and software systems using Python, Java, C++, and modern microservices architecture. Focus on algorithmic optimization, data structures, clean code, and API design.
mapua_degrees: BS Computer Science (CS) - Manila & Makati
BS Information Technology (IT) - Manila & Makati
BS Computer Engineering (CpE) - Manila
mapua_graduate_degrees: Master of Science in Computer Science (MS CS) - Mapúa Graduate Studies
Master of Engineering in Computer Engineering (M.Eng CpE)
side_project_blueprints: Build a Full-Stack Microservices API with Python FastAPI and PostgreSQL
Develop an Open-Source Developer CLI Tool with Git Integration
Create a Real-Time Collaborative Whiteboard App with WebSockets

stage_advice.freshman: Focus on building a rock-solid foundation in Python, C++, and discrete mathematics during your 1st year at Mapúa. Join Mapúa ACM or ICpEP student chapters early.
stage_advice.college_student: Select the Software Engineering Track. Focus on Data Structures & Algorithms coursework, maintain a clean GitHub profile, and participate in local hackathons.
stage_advice.job_seeker: Polish your Capstone project into a live production web service. Prepare for technical leetcode-style coding interviews and system design questions.
stage_advice.career_shifter: Enroll in Mapúa MS Computer Science (MS CS) or complete intensive full-stack software development professional certificates.

key_responsibilities: Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define software requirements
Debug, test, and deploy applications to production environments

career_roadmap.focus: Master syntax, version control, unit testing, and component architecture.
Lead feature implementations, code reviews, and system optimization.
Architect distributed systems, mentor engineers, and drive tech stack decisions.

title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
description: Build, train, and deploy advanced artificial intelligence algorithms, neural networks, and NLP systems. Utilize PyTorch, TensorFlow, vector databases, and MLOps tools to bring AI solutions to life.
mapua_degrees: BS Computer Science (CS) - Specialization in AI - Manila & Makati
BS Data Science (DS) - Makati
BS Computer Engineering (CpE) - Manila

Deep Learning & Big Data Analytics (BS DS)

Master of Science in Computer Science (MS CS) - AI Research Track
side_project_blueprints: Build a RAG AI Question-Answering Agent using Vector Databases and PyTorch
Train a Custom Computer Vision Model for Real-Time Object Detection
Develop an MLOps Pipeline for Automated Model Training and Cloud Deployment
certifications_and_licenses: Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer

stage_advice.freshman: Master Linear Algebra, Multivariable Calculus, and Python fundamentals during your freshman year at Mapúa.
stage_advice.college_student: Enroll in the Mapúa BS CS AI Specialization Track. Take electives in Neural Networks, Natural Language Processing, and Computer Vision.
stage_advice.job_seeker: Publish a machine learning side project on GitHub or Kaggle. Highlight your experience in fine-tuning LLMs and RAG architecture on your resume.
stage_advice.career_shifter: Enroll in Mapúa Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence (MS AI) or complete Andrew Ng's Deep Learning Specialization.

key_responsibilities: Train large language models (LLMs) and neural networks on specialized datasets
Build RAG pipelines and vector similarity indexing for intelligent agents
Deploy models to cloud endpoints with Docker and Kubernetes

career_roadmap.focus: Data preprocessing, basic model training, API wrapping.
Custom neural architecture design, fine-tuning, RAG optimization, MLOps.
Generative AI roadmap, foundation model research, enterprise AI integration.
